brief.title: Chocolate Retail Sales Performance Report (2023–2024)
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of chocolate retail sales transactions across stores, products, and customer segments for the 2023–2024 period.
brief.goal: Equip retail management with a clear understanding of sales trends, profitability drivers, discount effectiveness, and customer purchasing behavior to inform strategic decisions for the upcoming fiscal year.

required_sections.title: Executive Summary
required_sections.objective: Provide a high-level overview of total revenue, profit, order volume, and key highlights across the two-year period.

required_sections.title: Sales Trends Over Time
required_sections.objective: Analyze monthly and quarterly revenue and order volume trends across 2023 and 2024, identifying seasonality and growth patterns.

required_sections.title: Product & Category Performance
required_sections.objective: Evaluate which product categories, brands, and individual products generate the most revenue and profit, and assess cocoa percentage as a factor.

required_sections.title: Store & Geographic Performance
required_sections.objective: Compare sales performance across stores, cities, countries, and store types to identify top-performing and underperforming locations.

required_sections.title: Discount Impact & Profitability Analysis
required_sections.objective: Assess how discount levels affect revenue, profit margins, and order quantities to evaluate promotional effectiveness.

required_sections.title: Customer Behavior & Loyalty Insights
required_sections.objective: Examine purchasing patterns by customer demographics (age, gender) and loyalty membership status to identify high-value segments.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Sum of revenue across all transactions for the reporting period.

kpis.name: Total Profit
kpis.description: Sum of profit (revenue minus cost) across all transactions.

kpis.name: Average Profit Margin
kpis.description: Mean ratio of profit to revenue, expressed as a percentage.

kpis.name: Discount Utilization Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of transactions where a non-zero discount was applied.
